questions.cardDe: Was ist der Hindukusch: ein Gebirge, See oder Fluss?

questions.en: Which Central Asian mountain range, mostly in Afghanistan, has Tirich Mir as its highest peak?

timeline.labelEn: Ibn Battuta records the folk explanation of the name Hindu Kush (14th century)
timeline.labelDe: Ibn Battuta überliefert die volkstümliche Deutung des Namens Hindukusch (14. Jahrhundert)

questions.notes: Card answer: a mountain range (Gebirge). Reworked to ask for the range by its highest peak (Tirich Mir, 7708 m).
